decision_rules.gates_on_validation: A variant is ELIGIBLE only if, on validation (val_eval halves, temperatures fitted on val_fit): CHOICE vs Krun One v0: intent accuracy (kb_val core), val_hard accuracy and val_tools accuracy each drop by <= 0.5 pp; OOD AUROC (top1_top2_margin, kb_val and val_tools) drops by <= 0.01; ECE rises by <= 0.005. NOUL (in_domain, calibrated) vs the better Laya budget (512/192 or 1024/896) and vs Krun One v0: ROC-AUC higher, Brier lower, ECE not higher. SCORE (in_domain, calibrated) vs the better Laya budget and vs v0: MAE lower, Spearman higher, ECE and NLL not higher.
decision_rules.selection: Among eligible variants choose the highest mean of (noul in_domain ROC-AUC, score in_domain Spearman, mean choice accuracy over kb_val intents and val_tools). Differences < 0.003 on that mean -> the variant with the smaller choice regression; still tied -> M50_CE (simplest). If no variant is eligible: STOP, no candidate is promoted and noul/score stay private (MODEL_PRIMITIVES_READY=false).
decision_rules.score_confidence: See results/primitives_architecture_audit.md §7 (Spearman of confidence vs -|score - y| on score val_eval; normalized entropy kept unless another candidate beats it by > 0.02).
decision_rules.final: After results/primitives_decisions.json freezes the choice, the selected candidate is evaluated ONCE on the test sets: choice (KrunBench test intents, BFCL, holdout_tools — gate <= 0.5 pp drop vs v0 each), noul/score test (incl. external BoolQ / SST-5, eval-only), mixed requests. Nothing is tuned afterwards. The promotion gate (MODEL_PRIMITIVES_READY) requires every validation gate AND the final choice gate AND noul/score test in_domain better than Laya on the same metrics.
